message: Powerful 7.2 magnitude earthquake strikes Indonesia, tsunami warning issued.
Wildfires spread rapidly across California hills, thousands evacuated.
Heavy floods disrupt life in Bangladesh; relief operations underway.
Volcanic eruption in Iceland spews ash thousands of feet into air.
Cyclone damages coastal villages; emergency declared in the region.
Avalanche in the Alps kills 12 mountaineers, rescue in progress.
Drought conditions worsen in southern Africa, food shortage fears rise.
Tornado outbreak causes widespread damage across US Midwest.
Earthquake swarm detected near Tokyo raises concerns of major quake.
Severe floods hit Europe after record rainfall, cities underwater.
